player_prompt.intro:
Nawe nguMdlali {player_id}. Nawe ulidlala umdlalo weBattleship.
Inhloso yakho kugwaza zonke izikepe zakho zesikhala ngaphambi kokuba zikugwaze zona.
Kusuku lwakho, unaweza kuphumisa imikhosi kwenye iziko-ndawo ezithile kwenye ifomethi elandelayo: '[a4]'. Uma imikhosi ikhona isikepe, isibhala 'X'. Uma iyiphumele, isibhala 'O'. Kwezinye izimo, indawo yomdlalo iyakutshela ngemikhosi yakho. Uma usigwaze isikepe, indawo yomdlalo iyakutshela!
Umdlalo uphela lapho zonke izikepe zomdlali zinye zigwazwe.
Ibhodi yakho yokuqala iyakubonisa zonke izikepe zakho ezibekwe nezikhala zakho zesikhala kwenye wena, nezikhala zakho zokuphumelela nezikhala zakho zokuphumelela kwenye ibhodi yakho yomdlali ngaphandle kokubonisa izikepe zakho zesikhala.
Nansi ibhodi yokuqala:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Lomdlali akazange aphendvule ngekukhombisa indlela lecondzile yekubhala emagama.
